existing_limits.production_limits: set per plan with --max-bytes/--max-records/--max-output-disk; anything above the pilot caps requires recorded production admission

observations: The three components share the same raw rows; each row is admitted by at most one component, following the frozen precedence science, practical, prose.
Science is the sparse slice while its quota equals the practical quota and is twice the prose quota, so science bounds the rows that must be scanned.
Admission shares are descriptive counts over clustered 512-row windows, not rates with uncertainty.

stages.command: uv run --locked --extra cpu xlm data probe --catalog manifests/datasets.catalog.yaml --source essential_web --view <component> --live --budget-mib <MIB> --probe-id <ID> --json
stages.note: one per view; the stored essential_science probe is budget_exhausted

stages.command: uv run --offline --locked --extra cpu python scripts/mix01_inventory.py freeze --source essential_web --repo EssentialAI/essential-web-v1.0 --revision ce4eccc7e9604667b6d7f32cb6274b8b41f3113d --seed 20260918 --files <candidates.txt> --sizes <sizes.json> --output <DATA>/inventories/essential_web.inventory.json
stages.note: one inventory shared by the three views

stages.command: sample-blocks, plan (pilot caps), fetch, verify, then one adapt per component with --adapter essential_web_bnormal --adapter-config <component> --on-reject record
stages.note: one raw fetch feeds three adapts; the sample must be large enough for the sparse science slice

stages.command: uv run --offline --locked --extra cpu xlm data plan --source essential_web --view <component> --catalog manifests/datasets.catalog.yaml --files <ORDERED_PREFIX_CSV> --mode selected_records --row-ranges <rows.json> --adapter-spec essential_web_bnormal:<component> --seed 20260918 --max-bytes <BYTES> --max-records <RECORDS> --max-output-disk <BYTES> --output <plan.json>
stages.note: STOP after the plan hash is shown; no authorization is given here

stages.command: uv run --offline --locked --extra cpu xlm data admit --source essential_web --view <component> --adapter essential_web_bnormal --notes "<operator review notes>" --decision approve --license-review approved --benchmark-risk clean
stages.note: operator decision only; one per view

stages.command: uv run --locked --extra cpu xlm data fetch --plan <plan.json> --output-dir <raw> --scratch-dir <scratch>; then xlm data verify
stages.note: the fetch gate re-verifies probe evidence and the admission decision

stages.command: uv run --offline --locked --extra cpu xlm data adapt --plan <plan.json> --adapter essential_web_bnormal --adapter-config <component> --input <raw>/selected_records.jsonl --output-dir <canonical>/<component> --on-reject record --max-input-bytes <BYTES> --output-shard-bytes <BYTES>
stages.note: frozen B-normal admission happens here; rejection codes give the rejected, unassigned and other-component counts
